test_smart_ptr: test pybind11 smart pointer bindings by creating MyObject1, MyObject2, and MyObject3 instances and verifying ref counts
test_smart_ptr_refcounting: test pybind11 smart pointer reference counting by calling test_object1_refcounting on the C++ module
test_unique_nodelete: test unique_ptr with nodelete policy by creating MyObject4 instances and verifying cleanup_all_instances deletes them
test_shared_ptr_and_references: test shared_ptr holder types by creating SharedPtrRef and verifying set_ref and set_holder behavior for references and copies
test_shared_ptr_gc: test shared_ptr garbage collection by adding ElementA objects to an ElementList and verifying values survive gc_collect
